title: Fatal Traffic Accident

page_data.en:
French Municipal Police
----------------------
                                        409
                                        J 10 40

                        Shanghai, September 28, 1940.

                                REPORT

                Subject: Fatal Traffic Accident

        At about 2.55 p.m. to-day, tramcar No. F43
of No. 7 Route, driven by motorman No. 113 of the French
Tramway Company, was proceeding northwards along Route Say
Zoong, while motor car, licence No. 7720, driven by Mr.
J.R. Maughan, British subject, occupant of Room No. 47 of
Savoy Apartments, was coming from the opposite direction
moving along the track.
        When almost level with house No. 105 Route
Say Zoong, the motorman, noticing the motor car approaching
at high speed without turning aside, sounded his warning
apparatus, while Chinese Constable No. 844 on duty on the
tram, indicated with gestures to the chauffeur that he should
keep to the left.    The motor car, however, even increased
its speed, according to a witness, and the right front part
crashed into the right front part of the tramcar.
        The impact was terrible.    Mr. J.R. Maughan
was removed from his vehicle in an unconscious state and was
immediately taken to the Orthodox Hospital which is located
nearby, where the doctors pronounced his condition hopeless,
with fracture of skull and limb, chest crushed in.
        The front part of the motor car was completely
caved in, the lights, the radiator, the driving wheel and the
right wheel were smashed, the fly-wheel was twisted and the
windows were in pieces.    The bumper was twisted and the
apron was forced in to such a point that it was impossible to
make use of the hand brake.

（批：4/10/40）
page_data.zh:
法租界警务处
----------------------
                                        409
                                        J 10 40

                        上海，1940年9月28日。

                                报告

                事由：致命交通事故

        今日下午约2时55分，由法国电车公司第113号司机驾驶的7路F43号电车，正沿赛忠路（Route Say Zoong）向北行驶；与此同时，由英国籍人士J.R. Maughan先生驾驶、牌照号为7720的汽车，从相反方向沿轨道驶来。Maughan先生系萨伏伊公寓（Savoy Apartments）47室住户。
        当电车几乎行至赛忠路105号门牌平齐处时，司机注意到该汽车高速逼近且未避让，遂鸣响警示装置；而在电车上执勤的华捕844号也向司机打手势，示意其靠左行驶。然而，据一名目击者称，该汽车反而加速，其右前部撞上了电车的右前部。
        撞击极为猛烈。J.R. Maughan先生失去知觉后被从车内移出，并立即被送往附近的东正教医院（Orthodox Hospital）。医生诊断其伤势无望，头骨及肢体骨折，胸部压碎。
        汽车前部完全凹陷，车灯、散热器、方向盘及右轮均被撞碎，飞轮扭曲，车窗玻璃粉碎。保险杠扭曲，前挡泥板向内挤压，致使手刹无法使用。

（批注：1940年10月4日）

page_data.en:
- 2 -

At the scene, between the two rails, the
Traffic Department noticed a deep furrow of 4.80 m. (15 feet
9 inches) in length cut in the roadway which would seem to
indicate that the tram had pushed the motor car before it
came to a stop, contrary to the statement of the Constable
and the motorman who stated that the motorman had succeeded
in stopping his vehicle at the moment of impact.
Notwithstanding all this, there is no doubt whatever that
the motorman did everything possible to stop the tram as
traces of sand were noticed at this point of the road.

According to the investigation, there was no
vehicular traffic nor was any vehicle stationed near the
side walk on the east side of Route Say Zoong. Mr. Maughan
had then a free road to cross the tramcar while, on the
other hand, Route Say Zoong at this point being a straight
road he could have already seen it approaching.

At 4 p.m. the Orthodox Hospital informed
us that Mr. Maughan had succumbed to his injuries.

The British Consulate-General and Bubbling
Well Police Station were informed by Mr. Saint Oyant.

The body was left in the mortuary of the
Orthodox Hospital pending its removal to Thomas MacDonald's,
1076 Sinza Road, which was done at 10 p.m. through Sergeant
Gornwell of Bubbling Well Police Station acting in conformity
with the instructions of Mr. James, Coroner.

Mr. Maughan was the holder of driving permit
No. F1036.

(Signed) Durovray.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

在现场，交通科注意到两轨之间的路面上有一道深沟，长4.80米（15英尺9英寸），这似乎表明电车在停止前推动了汽车，这与巡捕及司机的陈述相悖，他们称司机在撞击瞬间成功停住了车辆。
尽管如此，毫无疑问，司机已尽一切可能停下电车，因为在该处路面上发现了撒沙的痕迹。

经调查，赛忠路东侧人行道附近既无车辆通行，也无车辆停放。因此，Maughan先生本有畅通的道路以避开电车；另一方面，由于赛忠路该路段为直路，他本应早已看到电车驶来。

下午4时，东正教医院通知我们，Maughan先生因伤身亡。

Saint Oyant先生已通知英国总领事馆及静安寺捕房。

遗体暂存于东正教医院停尸房，等待移往新闸路1076号Thomas MacDonald处。当晚10时，静安寺捕房Gornwell巡长遵照验尸官James先生的指示，执行了移送工作。

Maughan先生持有驾驶执照F1036号。

（签名）Durovray。

page_data.en:
French Municipal Police
----------------------

Shanghai, September 28, 1940.

STATEMENT OF OU GNO LING, AGED 30, NATIVE OF
TSENGKIANG, RESIDING AT NO. 106 SING SING LI,
ROUTE PERE ROBERT.

I am motorman No. 113 in the service of the
French Tramway Company.
To-day I was on duty from 1 p.m. to 6.30 p.m.
on tramcar No. F43 Route No. 7 which operated between Marche de l'Est and
Route Say Zoong.

At about 2.49 p.m. the tramcar which I was
driving was proceeding northwards along Route Say Zoong where
the line is a single track. I had almost reached the
level of house No. 107 when I noticed a motor car advancing
in my direction along the track. I sounded the bell with
the object of warning the driver of the motor car, who was
a European, so that he might make way. However, instead
of deviating, the chauffeur drove his vehicle at great speed
in my direction. In view of the circumstances, I was obliged
to make a manoeuvre to check the vehicle. At the moment
that the tramcar was brought to a complete stop, the motor car
dashed into the front part of the tramcar I was driving.
The radiator of the motor car was crushed in and the driver
was injured on the head.

The front part of the tramcar was also
damaged in the collision.

Chinese Constable No. 844, who accompanied
me, alighted from the tramcar and informed the Police by
telephone.
page_data.zh:
法租界警务处
----------------------

上海，1940年9月28日。

欧诺林（OU GNO LING，音译）供词，30岁，浙江人，住罗别特路（Route Pere Robert）星星里106号。

我是法国电车公司的第113号司机。
今日我于下午1时至6时30分值班，驾驶往返于东市场（Marche de l'Est）与赛忠路之间的7路F43号电车。

下午约2时49分，我驾驶的电车沿赛忠路向北行驶，该处线路为单轨。当我几乎到达107号门牌平齐处时，注意到一辆汽车沿轨道向我方向驶来。我鸣铃以警告身为欧洲人的汽车司机让其让路。然而，司机非但未避让，反而驾车高速向我冲来。鉴于当时情况，我不得不采取操作以制动车辆。就在电车完全停稳的瞬间，汽车撞上了我所驾驶电车的前部。汽车散热器被撞瘪，司机头部受伤。

电车前部也在碰撞中受损。

随同我的华捕844号下车，通过电话向警方报案。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The injured man was removed to hospital.
As for me, I drove the tramcar to the company.
This all I have to say.

Seen:

(Signed) Durovray.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

伤者被送往医院。
至于我，我将电车开回公司。
以上就是我要说的全部。

阅：

（签名）Durovray。

page_data.en:
French Municipal Police
--------------

Shanghai, September 28, 1940

STATEMENT OF P'EU YIE MING, 28, NATIVE OF SOOCHOW,
ACCOUNTANT OF THE ASIA REALTY COMPANY, 110 SZECHUEN
ROAD, RESIDING AT HOUSE NO. 2, FIRST FLOOR, PASSAGE 121
RUE RAYARD.

At about 2 p.m. to-day, I took a tram of No. 7
Route at the Joffre-Veyron stop to go to House No. 3,
Passage 237 Route Say Zoong off Avenue Haig.

At about 2.20 p.m., as the tram was proceeding
northward along Route Say Zoong near Route Dupleix, a motor
car driven by a European was proceeding southward along the
track on Route Say Zoong. As the line is a single track,
the motor man of the tramcar sounded the bell to notify the
motor car to leave the track. However, the motor car not
only failed to do so but it increased its speed.

Seeing this, the motor man immediately applied
the brakes, the motor car of the foreigner came into collision
with the front of the tram. The impact was a violent one,
the front part of the motor car was staved in and the foreigner
was so injured that he was rendered unconscious.

Chinese Constable No. 844, who was on duty on the
tramcar, first informed the Police of the accident and then
removed the injured man to a hospital.

Seen:

(Signed) Durevray.
page_data.zh:
法租界警务处
--------------

上海，1940年9月28日

皮一鸣（P'EU YIE MING，音译）供词，28岁，苏州人，四川路110号亚细亚地产公司（Asia Realty Company）会计，住雷雅尔路（Rue Rayard）121弄2号一楼。

今日下午约2时，我在霞飞-维隆站（Joffre-Veyron stop）乘坐7路电车，前往海格路（Avenue Haig）旁赛忠路237弄3号。

下午约2时20分，当电车沿赛忠路靠近杜普莱克斯路（Route Dupleix）处向北行驶时，一辆由欧洲人驾驶的汽车沿赛忠路轨道向南行驶。由于是单轨线路，电车司机鸣铃通知汽车离开轨道。然而，该汽车不仅未照做，反而加速。

见此情形，司机立即刹车，外国人的汽车撞上了电车前部。撞击十分猛烈，汽车前部被撞瘪，外国人受伤严重，陷入昏迷。

在电车上执勤的华捕844号首先向警方通报了事故，随后将伤者送往医院。

阅：

（签名）Durevray。

page_data.en:
French Municipal Police
----------
Shanghai, September 28, 1940.

STATEMENT OF TSANG TSING FONG, AGED 31,
NATIVE OF HUPEH

I am Constable No. 844 in the service of the
French Police. I am attached to the Reserve Unit.
To-day, I was detailed for duty between noon
and 6 p.m. to give protection to the motorman of tram car
No. F43.
At about 2.⁴⁵₅ p.m. to-day this tramcar was
proceeding northward along Route Say Zocag. At this
moment, a motor car approached in our direction at great
speed. The motorman sounded the bell while I shouted out
to the driver of the motor car, "Move away!" at the same
time making signs with my hands. However, the driver, who
was a European, continued on his way without paying heed
to our appeals. The motorman immediately applied the brakes
and the vehicle came to a stop immediately. The motor car,
license No. 7720, came dashed into the front part of the
tramcar.
The driver, who was alone in the motor car,
was injured and was removed to a hospital by a Russian
Policeman.

Seen:
(Signed) Durevray.
page_data.zh:
法租界警务处
----------
上海，1940年9月28日。

曾庆芳（TSANG TSING FONG，音译）供词，31岁，湖北人。

我是法国警察局的第844号巡捕，隶属于后备队。
今日，我被派值中午12时至下午6时的班，负责保护F43号电车司机。
今日下午约2时45分，该电车沿赛佐格路（Route Say Zocag，原文如此，应为赛忠路）向北行驶。此时，一辆汽车高速向我们方向驶来。司机鸣铃，同时我大声向汽车司机喊道：“让开！”并用手势示意。然而，身为欧洲人的司机对我们的呼吁置若罔闻，继续前行。司机立即刹车，车辆随即停住。牌照号为7720的汽车撞上了电车前部。
车内只有司机一人，其受伤后由一名俄国巡捕送往医院。

阅：
（签名）Durevray。

page_data.en:
French Municipal Police
------------------

Shanghai, September 28, 1940.

STATEMENT OF LIOU TSANG ZE, 48, NATIVE OF ANHWEI,
RESIDING AT NO. 3401, PASSAGE NO. 6 NAN YING HWA LI,
ROBISON ROAD.

Shortly after 2 p.m. to-day, I took a tramcar,
third class, of Route No. 7 at the stop on Route Pere Robert
to go home. Because of the large number of passengers, I
could not get into the compartment and I stood beside the
motorman. The tram was travelling south to north along
Route Say Zoong. When the vehicle reached the intersection
of Route Say Zoong and Route Dupleix, a motor car driven by
a foreigner was approaching along the track in my direction.
Upon noticing this, the motorman immediately sounded the
bell with the object of warning the driver to move away,
approached considerably (?) The motorman stopped his
vehicle by braking but the motor car dashed against the
front part of the tramcar. The driver, who was a
European, was injured, but nobody in the compartment of the
tramcar was injured.

Seen:
(Signed) Bureauay.
page_data.zh:
法租界警务处
------------------

上海，1940年9月28日。

刘昌泽（LIOU TSANG ZE，音译）供词，48岁，安徽人，住罗便臣路（Robison Road）南英华里6弄3401号。

今日下午2时许，我在罗别特路站乘坐7路三等电车回家。由于乘客众多，我无法进入车厢，便站在司机身旁。电车沿赛忠路由南向北行驶。当车辆到达赛忠路与杜普莱克斯路交叉口时，一辆由外国人驾驶的汽车沿轨道向我方向驶来。司机注意到这一点后，立即鸣铃以警告司机让路，距离相当近（？）司机通过刹车停住了车辆，但汽车仍撞上了电车前部。身为欧洲人的司机受伤，但电车车厢内无人受伤。

阅：
（签名）Bureauay。

交通科

关于车辆引起的公共道路事故报告

负责调查警官：辅助巡捕Kosloff。
1-- 伤者姓名、年龄及地址：J.R. Maughan先生（英国人），52岁，住赛忠路萨伏伊公寓47号。
2-- 事故日期及时间：1940年9月28日下午2时55分。
3-- 事故地点：赛忠路105号门前。
4-- 伤情性质：头骨骨折。下午4时死亡。
5-- 伤者被送往的医院名称：俄罗斯东正教医院。
6-- 目击事故的警官姓名或编号：华捕844号（后备队）。
7-- 证人姓名及地址：
1) 刘昌泽（Lio Tsang Zee，音译），48岁，罗便臣路永华里（Yong Hwa Lie，音译）。
2) 皮一鸣（P'eu Yih Ming，音译），28岁，拉塔德路（Rue Ratard）2号。
8-- 车辆种类：
1) 汽车，行驶方向：向南。
2) 电车，行驶方向：向北。
9-- 车主：1号车司机
姓名：J.R. Maughan先生，赛忠路（Route Say Zeeng，原文如此）萨伏伊公寓47号。
牌号或执照号：7720，福特轿跑车（Ford Coupe'）

Name: the victim himself.
Permit No.: F 1036
10-- Proprietor: Driver of No. 2
Name: C.F.T. (Compagnie Francaise de Tramways)
Disk or licence No. : F 43, Route No. 7
Name: Motorman No. 113.

Permit No. ......
11-- Details of the manner in which the accident occurred:-
From the statements of witnesses and judging
by the traces and the position of the vehicles, the following
results were obtained:-
The motor car, licence No. 7720, driven by its
owner Mr. J.R. Maughan, British, age 52 years, driving permit
No. F 1036, was proceeding south along Route Say Zoong along
the tram track. When level with House No. 105 on this road,
the motor car came into collision with tramcar No. F 43 of
Route No. 7, motorman No. 113 which was proceeding in the
opposite direction, northward. Upon seeing the motor car
moving along the track, the motorman applied the brakes and
opened the sand box. Notwithstanding these measures, the right
front part of the motor car crashed into the right front part
of the tramcar. The motor car was dragged northward for a
distance of about 5 metres (16 feet 5 inches) and came to a
stop facing north-east. Seriously injured in the head, the
owner of the motor car was immediately removed to the Russian
Orthodox Hospital where he died at 4 p.m.
At the scene, in the course of the investigation,
traces of the braking by the tramcar (sand) of about 9 metres
(29 feet 6 inches) in length were noted between the two rails.
A groove, made between the rails by the front part of the
motor car at the moment of the accident, measuring 4.80 metres
page_data.zh:
-2-

姓名：受害者本人。
执照号：F 1036
10-- 车主：2号车司机
姓名：C.F.T.（法国电车公司 Compagnie Francaise de Tramways）
牌号或执照号：F 43，7路
姓名：第113号司机。
地址：转交C.F.T.
执照号 ......
11-- 事故发生经过详情：-
根据证人陈述，并结合痕迹及车辆位置判断，得出以下结论：-
由车主J.R. Maughan先生（英国人，52岁，驾驶执照F 1036号）驾驶的牌照号7720汽车，正沿赛忠路电车轨道向南行驶。当行至该路105号门牌平齐处时，该汽车与迎面北行的7路F 43号电车（第113号司机）发生碰撞。司机看到汽车沿轨道行驶，便施加刹车并打开沙箱。尽管采取了这些措施，汽车的右前部仍撞上了电车的右前部。汽车被向北拖行约5米（16英尺5英寸）后停下，车头朝向东北。汽车车主头部受重伤，立即被送往俄罗斯东正教医院，于下午4时死亡。
在调查过程中，现场两轨之间发现了长约9米（29英尺6英寸）的电车刹车（撒沙）痕迹。在汽车前部于事故瞬间造成的两轨之间的沟槽，长4.80米

page_data.en:
-3-

(15 feet 8 inches) in length as well as some traces of skidding
by the rear wheels of the motcr car were noted on the dry
roadway. No traces of braking by the motor car. Serious damage
to the motor car (right front part, wind shield, steering
wheel); this vehicle was towed to the Traffic Department through
the assistance of "Auto-Hall". Serious damage to the right front
part of the tramcar; the vehicle was towed to the depot.

(Signed)
Chief of Traffic
Department.

Seen:
(Signed)
Deputy Commissioner,
Chief of Police.

Shanghai, September 29, 1940.
page_data.zh:
-3-

（15英尺8英寸），以及在干燥路面上发现的汽车后轮一些打滑痕迹。未发现汽车刹车痕迹。汽车严重受损（右前部、挡风玻璃、方向盘）；该车在“Auto-Hall”的协助下被拖至交通科。电车右前部严重受损；该车被拖回车场。

（签名）
交通科科长。

阅：
（签名）
副总监，
警务处处长。

上海，1940年9月29日。
